declaration.experiment: Iteration 9 Lee recurrent generated-unit sequence memory
declaration.candidate_law: Eight recurrent channels with 32-dimensional fixed hashed unit input; four signed .5 coordinates accumulated after deterministic32-bit avalanche. c=tanh(Wc*x+bc), z=sigmoid(Wz*x+bz), h_next=(1-z)*h_previous+z*c. BOS and every emitted unit advance the actual state, resetzero for each program. Each available candidate is scored using a hypothetical h_next; add .8*clip(dot(v,h_next),-4,4) to the existing logit. Candidate scoring does not advance actual state; chosen token advances once. Candidate set, original counts, source bytes and ordinary/provenance feedback remain unchanged.

sequence_readout_off.checkpoint: same replica sequence/final.json, only configure_sequence_memory(False); recurrent parameters and all other acquired memories retained

declaration.same_inputs: The two trained arms start from the published 800-game 2048 state and use identical corpus, generation/environment seeds, attempts and judge. The third frozen readout reuses the trained sequence checkpoint without extra training. Actual training trajectories can diverge.
declaration.primary: Completed episode score per original generated attempt; syntax/runtime/replay/encoding/truncation/timeout/worker/incomplete outcomes retain their slots and score zero.
declaration.gate: sequence minus baseline completed-score/raw positive in BOTH replicas, pooled gain>=25 points/raw, pooled completed count>=baseline. Third same-checkpoint readoutOFF is explanatory, not automatic promotion criterion. One candidate/parameter setting, no sweep.
declaration.controls: Uniform random legal and fixed greedy merge/empty/LDRU, all128 evaluation environment seeds; same128-move cap, no substitutions for generated programs.
declaration.decision_targets: Unchanged H8 discounted actual observed gains, gamma.9, available-window normalization, bounded episode-centered target with preserved mean. No oracle actions or action substitutions.
declaration.gallery_selection: Replica0 first fresh evaluation seed where sequence completes and baseline fails; ifnone first sequence-completed episode. Exact code/full real trajectory/first sequence probability witness, no score-based selection.
declaration.mechanism: Same128 frozen sequence-final generation seeds, fivevariants: genuine recurrentON; configure_sequence_memory(False); initialized wc/wz/bc/bz restored from same-life initialcheckpoint retaining learnedv/bias/steps; deterministic swapping of earlier recurrent-input units only, preservingBOS/firstemittedunit/multiset/final8units; state_zero scores eachcandidate from allzero prefixhidden using learnedhead/readout. No newgame/training or sourceediting. Recordexactsource/choices, matchedactualprefix candidate probabilities/hiddenstates and firstdiffering token. Genuine andOFFsources mustmatch closed evals; everyvariant fullsnapshot unchanged.
declaration.evidence: Source/bridge/input/declaration/runner freeze with SHA256 before firstmeasurement; JSON-native immutable per-index receipts, atomic closed journal plus shard hashes/readback. No replacement attempts. Finalbudget checkpoints only. Releasedstate nevermodified byrunner.

sequence_training.initialization: Independent random.Random(organism_seed XOR0x53455139); Wc gaussian sd.16, Wz gaussian sd.08, bc0,bz-2,v0,bias0. No consumption of sampling RNG.
sequence_training.loss: Mean binary crossentropy sigmoid(bias+dot(v,h)) against actual scalar episode reward at selected actual sampled-choice positions; failures use existing actual-error localization.
sequence_training.positions: Existing eligible ordinary-reward choices; sortunique positions and select min12 evenly spaced indices using i*N//min(12,N). Fullsource BPTT consumes BOS,all generated tokens,andEOS ifterminated. Emptytargets cause no update.
sequence_training.optimizer: One SGDupdate per eligible program; global gradientnorm clipped1; lr=.05/sqrt(1+steps/4000). Persistent steps/weights, no optimizer momentum.
sequence_training.sequence_lifecycle: Generation-local hidden state resetszero; stored parameters islandlocal. Explicitseed frozen evaluation leaves savedstate unchanged.
sequence_training.budgets: Original generationlimit1024 emitted-unit decisions and4096-byte stop retained; fullactualsequence tape, upto12losspositions.

candidate_design.candidate: bounded input-gated diagonal recurrent outcome head

features.kind: fixed sparse identity projection of ordinary learned unit ids

training.selection: sorted unique eligible choice tape positions; M positions, N=min(12,M), select positions[i*M//N] for i in0..N-1
training.loss: mean binary cross entropy over selected positions
training.unroll: full actual stream BOS+tokens+(EOS if terminated), no extra BPTT truncation
training.optimizer: one SGD after accumulating whole program
training.steps: increment once when at least one target exists

lifecycle.hidden_state: reset per generation, advance BOS then each emitted unit exactly once
lifecycle.weights: persist per life; off retains weights and stops readout/updates
lifecycle.experience_erasure: reset learned weights, retain active configuration

This retains BOS,index1 firstemittedunit,and last8. Recompute hiddenzero through the resulting entire sequence with head.advance, use only as _distribution(sequence_state=...) input. No changes to original history/candidates/emittedcode.
